# app-ads.txt — IAB Tech Lab spec
# Authorised sellers of ad inventory for the Tranquil Waters apps.
#
# Why this file exists: Google Play lists tranquilwaters.in as the developer
# website for these apps, so AdMob crawls tranquilwaters.in/app-ads.txt to verify
# the app belongs to this account. Without it AdMob applies "limited ad serving".
# Hydrate (Android) sat throttled on exactly this until 7 Aug 2026.
#
# Mirrors https://vaibhavrishikesh.github.io/app-ads.txt, which covers the apps
# whose store listings point at that domain instead.

google.com, pub-4765907187067298, DIRECT, f08c47fec0942fa0
google.com, pub-8683652483152886, DIRECT, f08c47fec0942fa0
